verdict.rationale: Close's official MCP server documents a `mcp.write_destructive` scope that can delete data, so there is a first-party deletion path for AI-native clients. Retention evidence is limited to a fixed 30-day event-log window and an 'Unlimited call recording retention' plan feature, neither of which is a user-configurable retention control. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, documented account or record purge/erasure workflows, deletion of recordings and backups, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: mcp.write_destructive — can read, write, and delete data
